name: Fancy Poker
des:
How to Play
Deal: All 52 cards are dealt face up into eight columns.
Move: Cards can be moved within the tableau or to the free cells. Only the top card of each column or free cell can be moved.
Build: Cards in the tableau can be built down in alternating colors (e.g., a red 5 on a black 6).
Foundation: Cards can be moved to the foundation piles, starting with Aces and building up in suit (e.g., Ace of Spades, 2 of Spades, etc.).
Win: The game is won when all cards are moved to the foundation piles.
Free Cell is a game of patience and strategy, requiring careful planning and efficient use of the free cells to create space and move cards effectively.
